assertions.text: Every output line matches the format '- [<TYPE>] <Summary> (#<id>)'
Lines appear grouped in the order FEAT, FIX, DOCS, CHORE
Input order is preserved inside each group (dark mode before CSV export; empty-input crash before typo)
The refactor bullet is typed CHORE
Exactly one output line per input bullet (6 lines, none dropped or merged)
Each summary is sentence case, has no trailing period, and is at most 60 characters
